implementation_amendment: v1 stopped for highspy addConstr rejecting warning status on coefficients around 1e-14. v2 rounds certified integer decisions and conservatively removes cut coefficients <=1e-9 with an explicit lower-bound correction. Same cohort, data, hyperparameters, paid outputs and all conditions reused. Partial failed v1 retained separately. This is an exploratory repair, not a new blind cohort.
phase: bounded exploratory milestone, not a submission-ready confirmatory study
selection: All 40 diet instances (source IDs 1 through 40), selected by domain before inverse results. No replacement for audit failures.
model: Nonnegative INTEGER food quantities, three nutrient lower bounds; check published objective and separately report continuous relaxation. Domain is reconstructed and integer semantics are not explicit in every source question.
split: source IDs divisible by 5 are development; others evaluation. Same-family numeric instances, not independent application domains.

primary.metric: mean held-out regret / max(1, oracle objective)

penalty: mean suboptimality divided by a fixed observed known-cost scale, plus lambda * sum(theta / 20). Fixed lambda; no tuning on evaluation outcomes.
candidate_bank: 2 masked original unit costs + 3 synthetic nutrient excess hinge penalties (true weights zero). This is a restricted dictionary baseline, NOT full unknown-matrix inverse optimization.
text: Deterministic Chinese log templates reveal hidden term semantics, never hidden values. One ambiguous nuisance statement. This is controlled synthetic text, not natural industrial logs or an end-to-end text-to-model benchmark.
noise: Feasible near-optimal MILP decisions: optimize a randomized auxiliary objective within the stated relative oracle gap cap. Cap is not the fraction of corrupted samples. Report realized gaps.
feedback: Start with one text cost feature omitted. Add the omitted bank feature with largest training residual decrease, one step. Uses only training data, not hidden weights or test losses. No claim of discovering arbitrary constraints.

llm.mode: non-thinking, archived exact prompts and responses; no raw source question or published answer sent

statistics: Paired within source problem. Average context losses before comparison; percentile paired bootstrap over source problem IDs, 5000 replicates, descriptive same-family intervals. Report all planned contrasts and failures, no significance-driven stopping.
stop: Complete the fixed available audited cohort and this grid, regardless of effect direction. Do not increase sample size or tune algorithms until a desired effect appears.
